title: Donut Chart
description: Parts of a whole, as a ring — with the one segment that matters wearing the core.
usage: For shares of a total with three to five parts. The segment the reader should act on takes the core; the rest stay in the accent family and zinc.
a11y: A chart is a picture of numbers: give the figure role="img" and an aria-label that states the conclusion ("Signups rose from 22 to 71 over the year"), and keep the data available as a table nearby.
